papers.title: Discrete dynamic survival analysis of epidemic case line lists
papers.summary: We found 2 t-tests and/or F-tests where effect sizes are not reported. Check these tests in the table below, and consider adding effect sizes.

findings.sentence: At ∆t = 1 d the DPH means exceed the corresponding continuous-time Erlang means, so estimates must be converted before they are compared with continuous-time ones.
findings.note: No effect size reported with this test.
